The sky is filled with dark, ominous clouds that resemble a tsunami wave, creating a sense of urgency and panic among the people present. The ocean appears turbulent, with waves crashing onto the shore. In the foreground, there are a few individuals on the beach. One person, wearing red shorts, is standing near the water's edge, seemingly observing the situation. Another person can be seen further back, closer to the center of the image, possibly taking a photo or video of the cloud formation.
